caption:
UWS Briefly · Sep 3–9

• Jake's Dilemma lost its lease and closes next month after 32 years at 430 Amsterdam. The space is already listed for rent.
• Raul Morales was indicted for attempted murder and assault as a hate crime in the July stabbings of two men on the UWS.
• A 48-year-old man was struck and killed by a 2 train at 72nd and Broadway on Monday morning.
• CB7 voted 41-1 to send Extell its “best and final offer” on affordable housing for the tower at the old ABC campus.
• Brasserie Boulud opens Sept. 17 at 1900 Broadway, where Daniel Boulud's three old places were.
• Ladder 25 on W. 77th is getting $400,000 in upgrades.
• The city wants seven UWS parking spots for curbside electric-car chargers.
• Columbia grad Michael Zheng's first U.S. Open ended in the third round. Further than you got.

Links to every story are in our bio.
Reporting by West Side Rag, I Love the Upper West Side.
